newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.

text.p: Mikuni and Co Ltd said on Friday it had assigned the following preliminary ratings to planned bond issues:
-AAA-
Ono Sokki Co Ltd, 40 million mark unsecured due 2000, private placement, guaranteed by Bank of Tokyo Mitsubishi.
-AA-
Hokkaido Electric Power Co Inc, 20 billion yen mortgaged due 2006.
-BBB-
Chugai Pharmaceutical Co Ltd,
25 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2008.
$50 million unsecured with warrants due 2000.
Daiei Real Estate & Development Co Ltd (Unlisted), 30 million Swiss Francs unsecured due 2000, private placement, guaranteed by Asahi Bank.
Dynic Corp, 60 million Swiss francs unsecured with warrants due 2000, private placement, guaranteed by Sakura Bank.
Harada Industry Co Ltd, 40 million Swiss francs unsecured with warrants due 2000, private placement, guaranteed by Asahi Bank.
-BB-
ALBIS Co Ltd, 0.375 billion yen unsecured with warrants due 1998.
Hankyu Corp, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2003.
ALTECH Co Ltd, 2.5 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement.
Koken Ltd, 20 million Swiss francs unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement.
Takasago Electric Ind Co Ltd, 0.45 billion yen unsecured with warrants due 2000.
-CC-
Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd, 30 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003.
